rationale: Both round-1 items are closed and verified at this pin rather than taken on the diff: dropping the *.sh filter means the hook walk now covers all eight files, and injecting echo "the current step is gated by R6" into each of the five previously-skipped bodies (pre-commit, pre-push, post-merge, post-commit, commit-msg) now fails the suite in every case where it passed before; the AGENTS.md fixture reads git show HEAD:AGENTS.md through removeManagedBlock, which I confirmed is immune to index state by staging a jargon-bearing blob and seeing no spurious failure, and asserting over the committed bytes is a better choice than my suggested worktree read because skip-worktree can leave the worktree stale relative to what ships; with the suite green at 439/439, every agent-facing surface scanning clean and the internal ids still present in steps.ts, analytics.ts and cli.ts, both acceptance criteria hold, and the only thing I would still flag — the stale .signals/issue-88/joined-cursor.json carrying the previous session's issueSessionId — is a current-issue coordination path that finalization deletes wholesale and is not worth a third round.
